name: Analog current signal isolator
summary: A current signal isolator transfers a documented analog current input to an output while providing the specified electrical separation.
description: A current signal isolator transfers a documented analog current input to an output while providing the specified electrical separation. Signal input, output and auxiliary supply are distinct terminal groups.
readingNotes: Determine active and passive current-loop roles at both interfaces.
